title: Simply supported beam response
description: Premium Three.js beam study linking a centered point load to reactions, shear, bending moment, and elastic deflection.
learningObjectives: Relate support reactions, shear, bending moment, and elastic deflection for a simply supported beam with a centered point load in one spatial visualization.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.2.0 replaces the flat renderer with a host-rendered Three.js scene while preserving the analytical model. Independent engineering, live-browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Premium 3D rebuild of reserved structures task str-beam-deflection; analytical model retained from the original repository contribution.
